chunks: "Whoever trims his nails on Thursday and leaves one for the day of Friday, Allah will remove poverty from him."
ai.seo_question: What is the hadith about trimming nails on Thursday and Friday?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches an etiquette related to personal cleanliness connected with Thursday and Friday. It presents this practice as a means by which Allah removes poverty from a person.
